newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: FIRE SWEEPS PART OF CZECH PARLIAMENT.
newsitem.headline: FIRE SWEEPS PART OF CZECH PARLIAMENT.

text.p: Fire broke out in the Czech parliament in a historic part of central Prague early on Thursday, injuring several firemen, the Czech news agency CTK reported.
CTK quoted the fire brigade as saying that several rooms in the building had been damaged in a newly reconstructed part of the baroque building before 3 am (0200 GMT), but the blaze had been put out.
It did not say how seriously the firemen had been hurt.
Parliament is not holding a plenary session but committee meetings are currently underway.
